title: A JWT is a compact, URL-safe way of representing claims to be transferred between two parties
summary: A JWT is a compact, URL-safe way of representing claims to be transferred between two parties.
body: RFC 7519 says a JSON Web Token is a compact, URL-safe means of representing claims to be transferred between two parties, with the claims encoded as a JSON object. The source says: "Sakimura NRI May 2015 JSON Web Token (JWT) Abstract JSON Web Token (JWT) is a compact, URL-safe means of representing claims to be transferred between two parties." A JWT represents claims. It does not, by being a JWT, make the claims true. Signature and encryption are specified in related documents and are how a recipient checks who produced the token, not whether the world matches the claim.
